verdict.rationale: Intel Gaudi 3 is an AI accelerator chip and card that customers install in their own servers or rent through third-party clouds. Choosing a data-storage region or residency is a capability of a hosted data service, not of accelerator hardware, so this story is the wrong axis for this kind of product. The one mention of trying Gaudi in the cloud refers to a host platform's offering, not a residency feature of Gaudi 3 itself.
